observations: Photo 0 shows a gas cooker top with 4 gas burners (two visible on left and two on right) and control knobs on the front.
Photo 1 shows the same cooker with 4 gas burners lit (blue flames visible) plus a central electric hotplate (round coil) and another electric hotplate (another round coil).
Photo 2 shows the full front of the cooker with a glass/metal top surface and multiple front control holes/knobs; no brand label is readable.

identity.kind: 6-burner gas/electric cooker (4 gas burners + 2 electric hotplates)

claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows 4 gas burners (with flames) and 2 electric hotplates (two round coil elements).
Photo 1 shows burners/hotplates with visible flames, but no full test of all functions (simmer/heat levels, oven/grill if present, thermostat, ignition consistency) is shown.

risks.risk: Some burners may be weak or fail to ignite consistently (photo shows only a moment of ignition).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video lighting each of the 4 gas burners one-by-one from cold, showing stable blue flame for 30–60 seconds.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed (worst case: treat as needing minor servicing/adjustment).

risks.risk: Electric hotplates may not heat properly or may have uneven heating.
risks.proof: Ask for a video turning on both electric hotplates and showing them heating (e.g., red glow/temperature rise) for several minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working (worst case: treat electric hotplates as faulty).

risks.risk: Oven/grill function may be missing or not working (photos only clearly show the cooktop).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the oven door/controls and a video of the oven heating (if it has an oven).
risks.if_unproven: Price as oven/grill not working or not confirmed.

risks.risk: Gas safety issues: burner caps/grates alignment, leaks, or damaged gas fittings.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the gas inlet/pipe connection area and a leak test demonstration (soap-water bubble test) if they can.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring inspection for gas safety.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: dents, rust, cracked glass/top, or missing knobs.
risks.proof: Ask for clear close-up photos of the top surface edges, burner caps, and all knobs/controls.

proof_requests: Video: light all 4 gas burners one-by-one from cold and show stable flame for 30–60 seconds each.
Video: turn on both electric hotplates and show heating/temperature rise for a few minutes.
Photos: close-ups of burner caps/grates, all knobs, and the gas inlet/connection area.
If there is an oven: photo of oven cavity/door and video showing oven heating.
response.reason: The photos support that it’s a 6-burner cooker (4 gas burners + 2 electric hotplates), but “all working perfectly” is not fully verifiable remotely (especially electric hotplates and any oven function). To price safely for Abuja pickup demand, we need proof of full operation.
